health_justification: The system shows moderate health with significant data gaps in BTP sector (20% pass rate, 33/100 avg score) and low source citation scores across all sectors (2.42-2.65/5). The LLM-Judge reveals factual accuracy is decent (3.31-3.88) but source citation is consistently weak, indicating missing authoritative documents. The system can handle basic queries but lacks depth for expert-level responses.

failure_patterns.root_cause: BTP sector lacks DTU norms, Eurocodes, AFNOR standards, and RE2020 documentation in vector stores
failure_patterns.suggested_fix: Ingest DTU norms, Eurocodes, CCTP templates, AFNOR standards, and RE2020 documentation into BTP vector store
failure_patterns.expected_improvement: +15-20 points on BTP standard pipeline score

failure_patterns.pattern: Weak source citation across all sectors
failure_patterns.root_cause: Vector stores lack authoritative legal and technical documents, forcing LLM to generate without proper citations
failure_patterns.suggested_fix: Expand document ingestion to include more authoritative sources: Code civil/commerce/travail articles, RGPD texts, jurisprudence databases, ISO norms, industry-specific regulations
failure_patterns.expected_improvement: +10-15 points on source citation scores across all sectors

failure_patterns.root_cause: Limited domain-specific vocabulary in vector stores leads to generic responses instead of expert terminology
failure_patterns.suggested_fix: Add industry glossaries, technical dictionaries, and sector-specific terminology databases to vector stores

new_test_questions.question: Quelles sont les exigences de l'Eurocode 2 pour le calcul des structures en béton armé dans les zones sismiques?
new_test_questions.expected_behavior: Detailed answer citing specific Eurocode 2 sections, including seismic design requirements, material specifications, and calculation methods with proper technical terminology
new_test_questions.edge_case_type: Technical standard citation - tests ability to retrieve and cite specific Eurocode requirements

new_test_questions.question: Comment appliquer la norme ISO 9001:2015 pour améliorer la gestion de la qualité dans une PME industrielle?
new_test_questions.expected_behavior: Comprehensive answer referencing ISO 9001:2015 clauses, implementation steps, documentation requirements, and quality management principles with specific examples
new_test_questions.edge_case_type: Standard implementation - tests practical application of ISO standards with real-world examples

new_test_questions.question: Quelles sont les implications du RGPD sur le traitement des données personnelles des employés dans les entreprises françaises?
new_test_questions.expected_behavior: Detailed legal analysis citing RGPD articles, CNIL guidelines, employee rights, employer obligations, and specific compliance requirements with proper legal terminology
new_test_questions.edge_case_type: Data protection compliance - tests ability to handle complex legal requirements with proper citations

key_insight: The system's fundamental weakness is missing authoritative technical and legal documents in vector stores, resulting in poor source citation scores (2.42-2.65/5) despite decent factual accuracy (3.31-3.88/5). This indicates the LLM has knowledge but cannot cite proper sources, which is critical for expert-level responses in professional domains.
next_action: Execute the ingestion workflow for DTU norms and Eurocodes documents into the BTP vector store, as this addresses the most critical data gap affecting the sector with the lowest performance (20% pass rate, 33/100 avg score).
